items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Paul Barber ain't coming behind the next night. He had about four hundred people.

ctx.x: That number sold. We put nine hundred, nine hundred people at the Gypsy Tea Room. We played there. We packed them in nine hundred that night. Paul Barber ain't coming behind the next night. He had about four hundred people. We went in on a Saturday night, Paul come in on a Sunday night.
That was Rick Snell was a trumpet player.
